 Who we are 
 CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.
 
 Job Summary 
We are looking for a motivated UI/UX Developer ready to take us to the next level! If you have demonstrated experience in the design, deployment, enhancement, and support of highly available, mission-critical applications serving public-facing and internal business functions, primarily on Microsoft Azure and Power Platform and are looking for your next career move, apply now. 
 Job Description 
 We are looking for a UI/UX Developer to develop and adapt front-end user interfaces per the design system and accessibility standards for the MetroAlerts notification platform. This position will be full-time and hybrid in Washington, DC. 
 What You'll Do 
 The Web Developer is responsible for designing, coding and modifying websites, from layout to function and according to the client’s specifications
 The Web Application developer develops, and adapts, the front end of applications according to the established design system, keeping accessibility in line with expectations
 The Web Application developer uses the same tools and technologies that are in use and applies industry best practices for User Experience design
 A Web Application Developer develops application user interfaces within the requirements of accessibility and the design system
 The Web Application Developer uses modern technologies and methods to capture user requirements
 The Web Application Developer will contribute to the design system when new elements are built and maintain existing UI components
 There is a clear expectation for team collaboration and the use of the Agile methodology
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and/or a combination of education and experience that provides an equivalent level of competency
 What You'll Need 
 Required: 
 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and/or a combination of education and experience that provides an equivalent level of competency
 8 years of experience
 Demonstrated experience in the design, deployment, enhancement, and support of highly available, mission-critical applications serving public-facing and internal business functions, primarily on Microsoft Azure and Power Platform
 Candidates must have expertise in the tools, governance frameworks, security practices, and delivery methodologies commonly employed by large enterprises to develop, integrate, and maintain complex business applications
 Front end: strong React or Angular experience
 HTML/CSS/JavaScript/TypeScript; component-based, responsive design experience 
 UX/usability: design systems, wireframing and prototyping, responsive web design, user journey mapping, streamlined alert creation and oversight workflows that reduce cognitive load in time-sensitive MICC operations 
 Accessibility: Section 508 / WCAG compliance (critical for public-facing and accessibility/ELSTAT alerts)
 Integration: consuming REST APIs and GTFS-driven data; rendering into web, Rider Tools, and signage/PIDS contexts 
 Cloud/DevOps: familiarity with Azure hosting (Container Apps), Git, and CI/CD deployment
 Legacy transition: awareness of migrating off the legacy Power Apps Portals front end onto the modular Azure architecture
 Preferred:
 Master’s degree in computer science or a related field 
 PeopleSoft certified
 Experience in working with third-party systems
 Experience in cloud-based PeopleSoft deployments
 Physical Demands 
 Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA and other federal, state, and local standards
 Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings, etc.
 Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor
